acceptance: writeCycleDossier takes at most 3 parameters (lock, params struct, and any context), with every current field preserved by name.
Adding a hypothetical new evidence field compiles without editing unrelated call sites — demonstrated by a test or by the diff shape.
go vet + internal/core and internal/dossier suites green; no behavior change (the dossier bytes for a fixed input are unchanged).
connects_to: the 2026-09-11 dossier-evidence projection fix, which added the 11th parameter and surfaced this
fix: Introduce core.cycleDossierParams (or reuse a narrowed view) mirroring dossier.BuildOpts; pass one struct. Field additions then touch only the producer and the site that supplies the new field.
notes: Raised by the go-reviewer as MEDIUM, explicitly non-blocking, on the dossier-evidence PR. Filed rather than folded in to keep that diff focused on the reporting defect.
root_cause: The function grew by accretion; each new piece of cycle evidence the dossier needs becomes another trailing parameter, so every call site churns for a change that concerns none of them.
summary: core.writeCycleDossier now takes 11 positional args (lock, projectRoot, workspacePath, cycle, goal, runID, outcome, skipped, notAdopted, spineFailOpens, phaseTimings). Adding the 11th (the live phase timings, the dossier-evidence fix) required touching all 15 call sites purely to append a positional value. One frame down, the same code already demonstrates the better pattern: dossier.Build(cycle, dossier.BuildOpts{...}).
title: writeCycleDossier takes 11 positional parameters — convert to a params struct mirroring dossier.BuildOpts
